title: Your workspaces
intro: Work together privately on a problem. Only explicitly invited members have access.
name: Working title
memberHelp: Contributors edit their own entries. Owners can delete entries but cannot rewrite other people’s statements. Viewers can only read.
inviteHelp: Access starts only after signing in with the verified invited email address and accepting. The invitation grants no other CONNECT permissions.
failed: Not sent. You can share the personal link.
rotate: Create and send a new link
rotateHelp: A new link replaces the old one. Wait at least a minute before rotating again.
claimHelp: Accept with the account for the invited, verified email address. You gain access only to this private workspace.
invalid: The invitation has expired, was revoked or used, or does not match your verified email address.
error: The action could not be completed. Check your input and access, and reload the page if needed.
sourceHelp: Sources provide context, not proof of validation. They are not fetched automatically.
emptyEntries: What do you observe? What do you already know? What is still an assumption? Which perspectives are missing? What could you try next?
freeOrder: These are prompts, not required steps. Start with any entry.
noneType: No entries of this type yet.
archiveCheck: End editing and revoke pending invitations
archiveHelp: Archived workspaces remain readable for authorized members. The owner can explicitly reopen them; old invitations remain revoked.
privacy: Nothing here is automatically published: no names, entries or sources.
sourceNotice: This workspace links to your existing active problem. The problem stays unchanged; nothing from this workspace flows back automatically.
inviteDisclosure: You can revoke invitations or remove members. Previously read content cannot be recalled.

hints.observation: What was actually seen or experienced?
hints.perspective: How does an affected person or group describe the problem?
hints.assumption: What do we suspect but not yet know?
hints.test: What could we try to learn something?

development.publishHelp: Write a separate problem version deliberately. Private entries, contributor names, roles, invitations and sources are never copied. An existing version prefills only its previous publication fields.
development.publicAuthor: These details appear with your existing CONNECT author identity under the selected visibility rules. Other workspace members are not named.
development.confirmPublish: I have reviewed the preview and approve exactly these details for the selected visibility.
development.publicationUnavailable: The linked version is no longer active or you no longer have editing rights. No replacement is published automatically. Your private workspace data stays intact.
development.publicationError: Publication failed. Check your input and active CONNECT profile. If the linked version changed, review the preview again.
development.profileRequired: Publishing requires active CONNECT membership and an active CONNECT profile.
development.publicationInactive: Linked version is not currently published
development.publicationRestricted: A problem version is linked. Workspace access grants no additional permission to read it.
development.opportunityHelp: An opportunity records a hypothesis: for whom could a change be valuable? An approach is a possible direction within your exploration. Both stay private and do not establish market validation.
development.title: Opportunity title
development.affectedGroup: For whom is this problem particularly relevant?
development.statement: What opportunity do you see in it?
development.value: What change could be valuable for these people?
development.referencesHelp: Optionally choose up to 50 entries from this workspace. These are internal references, not evidence of validation. They stay private and are not copied into a venture.
development.ventureHelp: You can link one venture. The opportunity remains in the workspace. Other members do not automatically become founders; an explicit founder invitation is still required. The venture gains no access to private workspace data.
development.confirmNewVenture: I am starting this new venture alone. Nobody else will be added as a founder.
development.founderRequired: Creating a venture requires existing founder access. Workspace membership does not grant it automatically.
development.confirmLink: I am linking this opportunity to the explicitly selected venture. Private content will not be transferred.
development.linkedRestricted: Linked to a venture. Details are visible only to already authorized team members.
development.archiveHelp: Stop editing this opportunity. Linked ventures and published problems remain intact.The owner can explicitly reopen this opportunity later.
development.restoreOpportunityHelp: This opportunity becomes editable again in the active private workspace. Its venture link remains unchanged; the venture and public content are not modified.

radarImport: Radar starting context · The named person performed the import, not authored the external source. Later independent edits are retained separately.
restoreHelp: This private workspace becomes editable again with its existing members. Revoked invitations and old tokens stay invalid. Published problems and archived opportunities do not change.
restoreConfirm: I want to reopen this workspace with these consequences.
